newsitem.title: BELGIUM: KREDIETBANK EGM MOVED TO APRIL 24.
newsitem.headline: KREDIETBANK EGM MOVED TO APRIL 24.

text.p: Belgian bank Kredietbank said an extraordinary general shareholders meeting due to be held on Friday had been moved to alongside its annual general meeting on April 24.
Kredietbank said not enough shareholders had registered to make Friday's meeting legal.
Shareholders are being asked to renew the bank's poison pill clause in its statutes, enabling the board to issue up to nine billion francs in fresh capital in the case of a takeover bid.
